results.title: [PDF] SFDR disclosures - Longship
results.content: Longship Fund I General Partner Limited in its capacity as manager of Longship Fund I LP and Longship Fund I Co-investment LP (“Longship”) has implemented a Compliance and ESG Policy, which sets out, amongst other matters, how sustainability risks are integrated into its investment decision-making process. While Longship will continue to take into account ESG factors in our investment process, Longship does not consider the principal adverse impacts of investment decisions on sustainability factors as specifically set out in the SFDR, as the investment strategies of Longship Fund I LP and Longship Fund I Co-investment LP were agreed with investors prior to the publication of the SFDR and did not include such criteria. Longship considers its existing due diligence process and Compliance and ESG Policy to be appropriate and proportional to the investment strategies of Longship Fund I LP and Longship Fund I Co-investment LP.
